The '''I2F series manufacturing droid''' was a model of [[Industrial droid/Legends|industrial droid]]. It was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], commonly assigned to staff the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-industrial complex of Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]].<ref name="IG" />
